content:
sara: Hey team, seeing a sudden surge of 503s from the inference gateway starting ~10:40 UTC. Affects many orgs, ~15% error rate. dashboard: https://grafana/reports/reqs-503
infra-bot: ALERT: 503-rate spike detected (service=inference-gateway, 10m avg ↑ 12%). Pager sent to #incidents.
mike: On it. Any recent deploys to quota/applier or console in last hour?
jiwoo: I merged a console change ~09:50 UTC that adds a "min_burst" clamp to new quota edits so we don't set 0 by accident. PR: https://git/redwood/console/pull/452
abhi: That change should be safe. But the rollout job also had a migration that backfilled min_burst for orgs without the field. I just saw a job kicking off at 10:35 UTC: rollout-quota-backfill-2026-03-20
sara: Correlation: 10:35 UTC job start == spike start. Can we get logs from quota-applier? m/s for top errors
mike: Piping logs now. key snippet:
```
[10:36:12] quota-applier INFO applyQuota org=acme min_burst=1000
[10:36:12] quota-applier WARN applied global-cap-floor org=acme old_burst=0 new_burst=1000
[10:36:15] gateway ERROR backend throttle exceeded -> 503
```
abhi: Wait min_burst=1000? PR default was 10. Looks like the env var QUOTA_MIN_FLOOR was set to 1000 in the rollout job by accident (typo in terraform var).
jiwoo: Ugh typo in the Terraform var file: `quota_min_floor = 1000` not `10`. I missed that in the plan output. That backfill applied to ~3k orgs.
mike: That explains the burst allowance causing downstream backend saturation — too many warm tokens allowed to be consumed quickly -> DB + GPU spikes -> 503s.
sara: Immediate action: revert the backfill. Can we stop the job and run compensating migration to clamp back to previous values?
console-bot: Revert initiated for console PR 452 -> rolling back migration steps.
abhi: Running emergency migration to reset min_burst for orgs touched by job: `update quotas set min_burst=coalesce(previous_min,0) where backfill_tag='rollout-2026-03-20'` — executing now (read-only dry run initially).
mike: Also scaling gateway and rate-limiter to reduce 503s: `kubectl scale deployment/gateway --replicas=10 -n prod` and bumping token-throttle to conservative limits.
infra-bot: Autoscale triggers: extra pods scheduled. Observability: 503 rate starting to decline at 10:48 UTC.
sara: Good. Patch for the terraform var and PR for backfill cleanup? We need a canary and a scoped backfill only for orgs that opted in.
jiwoo: I'll open PR to fix terraform default -> set to 10 and add plan guardrails. Also add an explicit canary flag for backfills.
abhi: Running the compensating migration now. Summary of affected: ~3100 orgs had min_burst set to 1000; we'll set to previous_min or 10 where unknown.
sara: After migration finished, error rate dropped back to baseline by 10:58 UTC. Confirming no more cascading 503s.
mike: Filing incident ticket: INC-2026-0312. Root cause: rollout backfill misconfigured env var (quota_min_floor set to 1000) causing large per-org burst floor and downstream saturation. Impact: transient 503s ~10:35–10:58 UTC for many orgs; some high-throughput orgs saw request errors and higher cost.
abhi: Hotfix checklist:
- rollback backfill (done)
- revert terraform var + add lint (in PR)
- add dry-run and canary for migrations
- improve dashboards to show per-org applied quota changes
- add alert: sudden global bump in sum(min_burst) > threshold

jiwoo: Agreed. I'll push follow-ups. Also we should show the exact plan output in the PR so reviewers can catch numeric typos.
sara: Postmortem owners: jiwoo (console), abhi (migration), mike (rate limits/op), sara (SRE lead). Let's meet 14:00 UTC for postmortem draft.
mike: Quick note: add a guard in quota-applier to reject min_burst > 500 unless explicit override. That would have prevented this from applying broadly.
abhi: I'll add that guard and a feature flag to enable for specific orgs.
jiwoo: Thanks everyone. Sorry for the slip — learned to never trust a terraform var default without plan review :grimacing:
sara: Nice response. Closing channel for now, will update after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
